fitted_from.note: PROVISIONAL, for verifying the recorded booster run only: fit_course.py's alpine entry fits only the boosters. The start area is the hull of run 0's poses before tick 1085, 1 block out, with its +z face between ticks 1086 and 1087 (the timer chat at 1090 judged one of 1085..1088); the finish is 1 block around the pose at 1506 (the finish chat at 1510). The boosters are fitted by `fit_course.py alpine --boosters-into` (fitted_from.boosters).
